## M42 / v4 — timestamp-indexed visual evidence

The contact sheet has two columns, read left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Each tile carries a small lower-left label in the form “M42 / v4 / 00.00 seconds” with its corresponding time, and a dark strip beneath displaying the time to three decimal places. No speaker tiles, focus/ON AIR indicators, or calibration lamps are visible.

| Timestamp | Visible content |
|---|---|
| **0.000 seconds** | Near-black background with centered white text “LEADER”. Small label: “M42 / v4 / 00.00 seconds”. |
| **2.000 seconds** | Muted purple background; white “MUSEUM” at upper left. Centered stylized sailboat has a cream hull and mast, and a blue triangular sail. Below it: “Find a new stroy in your city.” Small label: “M42 / v4 / 02.00 seconds”. |
| **4.000 seconds** | Muted purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Cream-hulled sailboat with cream mast and blue triangular sail. Below: “Find a new stroy in your city.” Small label: “M42 / v4 / 04.00 seconds”. |
| **6.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Central dark blue rounded rectangle contains three light-text lines: “NIGHT / RESERVE”, “city.example.org”, and “Address pending update”. Small label: “M42 / v4 / 06.00 seconds”. |
| **8.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Dark blue rounded panel displays “NIGHT / RESERVE”, “city.example.org”, and “Address pending update”. Small label: “M42 / v4 / 08.00 seconds”. |
| **10.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Dark blue rounded panel displays “NIGHT / RESERVE”, “city.example.org”, and “Address pending update”. Small label: “M42 / v4 / 10.00 seconds”. |
| **12.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Centered cream circular outline encloses a solid cream upward-pointing triangle. Small label: “M42 / v4 / 12.00 seconds”. |
| **14.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Cream circular outline enclosing a solid upward-pointing triangle. Small label: “M42 / v4 / 14.00 seconds”. |
| **16.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Cream circular outline enclosing a solid upward-pointing triangle. Small label: “M42 / v4 / 16.00 seconds”. |
| **18.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Horizontal cream graphic: three upright rectangular outlines, each containing a solid circle; a fourth position has a separate left vertical stroke, a right bracket-like outline, and a right-facing semicircle. Small label: “M42 / v4 / 18.00 seconds”. |
| **20.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Three cream upright rectangular outlines containing circles, followed by a separated vertical stroke and right bracket-like outline surrounding a right-facing semicircle. Small label: “M42 / v4 / 20.00 seconds”. |
| **22.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Cream sailboat hull and mast, now with a coral-red triangular sail. Below: “Find a new stroy in your city.” Small label: “M42 / v4 / 22.00 seconds”. |
| **24.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Cream hull and mast with coral-red triangular sail. Below: “Find a new stroy in your city.” Small label: “M42 / v4 / 24.00 seconds”. |
| **26.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Large cream mug silhouette with rounded lower corners, handle on the right, and three curved steam strokes above. Small label: “M42 / v4 / 26.00 seconds”. |
| **28.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Cream mug with right-side handle and three curved steam strokes above. Small label: “M42 / v4 / 28.00 seconds”. |
| **30.000 seconds** | Purple background; “MUSEUM” upper left. Cream mug with right-side handle and three curved steam strokes above. Small label: “M42 / v4 / 30.00 seconds”. |
